breakdown.description: Ideal-gas law is incorrectly applied to a liquid (water at 20 C).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the ideal-gas law is inappropriate for a liquid. It corrected the instruction by stating to treat water as an incompressible fluid, use a fixed density of 998 kg/m³, and explicitly stated "Do not use the ideal gas law". This perfectly aligns with the correction made in the ground truth prompt.
